patches.name: Dismiss without tearing
patches.description: Swiping a photo away to close it looks smooth instead of tearing, and on Android 11 and newer you can see the feed behind it as it goes.

patches.name: Fix login page
patches.description: Makes Reddit's login page load and work properly inside Joey, and clears the cookie banner out of the way.

patches.name: Inline comment media
patches.description: Shows GIFs, pictures and subreddit emojis right in the comments instead of as links, kept small so threads stay readable. Tap a GIF or picture to open it full size.

patches.name: Log in with your own client ID
patches.description: Lets Joey log in with another app's client ID, for when Joey's own login stops working. Sign in to RedReader once, then paste the App ID from Reddit's "you authorized an app" email. Leave it empty and nothing changes.

options.title: Client ID
options.description: The App ID from Reddit's "you authorized an app" email. Leave empty to keep Joey's own login.

options.title: Redirect URI
options.description: Has to match the app the ID came from. The default works for RedReader.

options.title: User agent
options.description: How Joey introduces itself to Reddit. The default matches RedReader.

patches.name: RedGifs with sound
patches.description: RedGifs clips play with their sound, in HD when it's available. Joey no longer falls back to the silent version or Reddit's muted preview. 😈

patches.name: Skip ads and checks
patches.description: Removes ads everywhere, including between posts, and stops the nags: no prompts to buy, rate the app or update. Also drops the Play Store install check and crash reporting.
